title: Hanuma enters Ravana's house
introduction: In this Chapter Hanuma has first glimpse of Ravana in his house. He also observes various wives of Ravana sleeping in the house. He sees Mandodari and thinks her to be Seetha.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामयने आदि काव्ये सुन्दर काण्डे दशमः सर्गः

verses.devanagari:
तत्र दिव्य उपमम् मुख्यम् स्फाटिकम् रत्न भूषितम् |
अवेक्षमाणो हनुमान् ददर्श शयन आसनम्
दान्तकाञ्चनिचित्राङ्गेर्वैश्च वरासनैः |
महार्हस्तरणोपेतैरुपपन्नम् महाधनैः
verses.iast:
tatra divya upamam mukhyam sphāṭikam ratna bhūṣitam |
avekṣamāṇo hanumān dadarśa śayana āsanam
dāntakāJṇcanicitrāṇ^gervaiśca varāsanaiḥ |
mahārhastaraṇopetairupapannam mahādhanaiḥ
verses.translation: In that house, while observing, Hanuma saw a portion of house with beds and couches, consisting of best couches equaling those in heaven, made of crystal decorated with diamonds, with wonderful parts made of ivory and gold, covered with best beds made of cat's eye gems of great value.

glosses.meaning: (a portion of house with) beds and couches
with wonderful parts made of ivory and gold
covered with best beds made of cat's eye gems

verses.devanagari:
तस्य च एकतमे देशे सो अग्र्य माल्य विभूषितम् |
ददर्श पाण्डुरम् चत्रम् तारा अधिपति सम्निभम्
verses.iast:
tasya ca ekatame deśe so agrya mālya vibhūṣitam |
dadarśa pāṇḍuram catram tārā adhipati samnibham
verses.translation: Hanuma saw in a part of that room, an umbrella white in colour decorated with best flower garlands and resembling moon - the lord of stars.

glosses.meaning: and resembling moon the lord of stars.

verses.devanagari:
जातरूपपरिक्षिप्तम् चित्रभानुसमप्रभम् |
अशोकमालाविततम् ददर्श परमासनम्
verses.iast:
jātarūpaparikśiptam citrabhānusamaprabham |
aśokamālāvitatam dadarśa paramāsanam
verses.translation: Hanuma saw an excellent couch made of gold with radiance equaling that of fire, spread by garlands of Ashoka flowers.

glosses.meaning: with radiance equaling that of fire
spread by garlands of Ashoka flowers.

verses.devanagari:
वाल व्यजन हस्ताभिर् वीज्यमानम् समन्ततः |
गन्धैः च विविधैर् जुष्टम् वर धूपेन धूपितम्
verses.iast:
vāla vyajana hastābhir vījyamānam samantataḥ |
gandhaiḥ ca vividhair juṣṭam vara dhūpena dhūpitam
verses.translation: Fanned by women with fans in their hands in all the four directions and obtained by various fragrances fumigated by the best incense.

glosses.meaning: by women with fans in their hands

verses.devanagari:
परम आस्तरण आस्तीर्णम् आविक अजिन सम्व्र्तम् |
दामभिर् वर माल्यानाम् समन्ताद् उपशोभितम्
verses.iast:
parama āstaraṇa āstīrṇam āvika ajina samvrtam |
dāmabhir vara mālyānām samantād upaśobhitam
verses.translation: Covered by an excellent bed, spread by sheep skin everywhere and shone by rows of excellent garlands.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मिन् जीमूत सम्काशम् प्रदीप्त उत्तम कुण्डलम् |
लोहित अक्षम् महा बाहुम् महा रजत वाससम्
verses.iast:
tasmin jīmūta samkāśam pradīpta uttama kuṇḍalam |
lohita akṣam mahā bāhum mahā rajata vāsasam
verses.translation: Hanuma saw Ravana in that house, equaling a cloud, wearing earrings with a brilliant shine with red eyes and with long arms wearing gold clothes.

glosses.meaning: wearing earrings with a brilliant shine

verses.devanagari:
लोहितेन अनुलिप्त अन्गम् चन्दनेन सुगन्धिना |
संध्या रक्तम् इव आकाशे तोयदम् सतडिद् गुणम्
verses.iast:
lohitena anulipta angam candanena sugandhinā |
saṃdhyā raktam iva ākāśe toyadam sataḍid guṇam
verses.translation: With his body smeared with red sandal-wood with good fragrance like a cloud in the red sky at sunset, together with groups of lightening.

glosses.meaning: like a cloud in the red sky at sunset

verses.devanagari:
वृतम् आभरणैर् दिव्यैः सुरूपम् काम रूपिणम् |
सव्र्क्ष वन गुल्म आढ्यम् प्रसुप्तम् इव मन्दरम्
verses.iast:
vṛtam ābharaṇair divyaiḥ surūpam kāma rūpiṇam |
savrkṣa vana gulma āḍhyam prasuptam iva mandaram
verses.translation: Ravana was filled with excellent jewellery, with a good appearance, with an ability to assume desired form, resembling mount Mandara in sleep, together with groups of trees and bushes.

glosses.meaning: with ability to assume desired form
together with groups of trees and bushes.

verses.devanagari:
क्रीडित्वा उपरतम् रात्रौ वर आभरण भूषितम् |
प्रियम् राक्षस कन्यानाम् राक्षसानाम् सुख आवहम्
verses.iast:
krīḍitvā uparatam rātrau vara ābharaṇa bhūṣitam |
priyam rākṣasa kanyānām rākṣasānām sukha āvaham
verses.translation: Resting after having pleasure at night, bedecked with the best ornaments, he was a lover to the rakshasa girls and causing comfort to rakshasas.

verses.devanagari:
पीत्वा अपि उपरतम् च अपि ददर्श स महा कपिः |
भास्करे शयने वीरम् प्रसुप्तम् राक्षस अधिपम्
verses.iast:
pītvā api uparatam ca api dadarśa sa mahā kapiḥ |
bhāskare śayane vīram prasuptam rākṣasa adhipam
verses.translation: That great Hanuma saw the gallant king of rakshasas in sleep on a shining couch resting after drinking.

verses.devanagari:
निह्श्वसन्तम् यथा नागम् रावणम् वानर उत्तमः |
आसाद्य परम उद्विग्नः सो अपासर्पत् सुभीतवत्
verses.iast:
nihśvasantam yathā nāgam rāvaṇam vānara uttamaḥ |
āsādya parama udvignaḥ so apāsarpat subhītavat
verses.translation: That Hanuma, best among Vanaras neared Ravana, became very gloomy and moved away with great dread, as though from a hissing serpent.

glosses.meaning: as though from a hissing serpent.

verses.devanagari:
अथ आरोहणम् आसाद्य वेदिका अन्तरम् आश्रितः |
सुप्तम् राक्षस शार्दूलम् प्रेक्षते स्म महा कपिः
verses.iast:
atha ārohaṇam āsādya vedikā antaram āśritaḥ |
suptam rākṣasa śārdūlam prekṣate sma mahā kapiḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter the great Hanuma neared staircase, sought another dais and observed closely Ravana.

verses.devanagari:
शुशुभे राक्षस इन्द्रस्य स्वपतः शयन उत्तमम् |
गन्ध हस्तिनि सम्विष्टे यथा प्रस्रवणम् महत्
verses.iast:
śuśubhe rākṣasa indrasya svapataḥ śayana uttamam |
gandha hastini samviṣṭe yathā prasravaṇam mahat
verses.translation: The excellent couch of the sleeping Ravana shone like a great lake when a scented elephant resides in it.

glosses.meaning: when a scented elephant resides (in it).

verses.devanagari:
कान्चन अन्गद नद्धौ च ददर्श स महात्मनः |
विक्षिप्तौ राक्षस इन्द्रस्य भुजाव् इन्द्र ध्वज उपमौ
verses.iast:
kāncana angada naddhau ca dadarśa sa mahātmanaḥ |
vikṣiptau rākṣasa indrasya bhujāv indra dhvaja upamau
verses.translation: That Hanuma also saw the wealthy Ravana's arms tied with golden armlets thrown apart, resembling flag staffs raised in honor of Indra.

glosses.meaning: resembling flag staffs(raised in honor ) of Indra.

verses.devanagari:
ऐरावत विषाण अग्रैर् आपीडित क्र्त व्रणौ |
वज्र उल्लिखित पीन अंसौ विष्णु चक्र परिक्षितौ
verses.iast:
airāvata viṣāṇa agrair āpīḍita krta vraṇau |
vajra ullikhita pīna aṃsau viṣṇu cakra parikṣitau
verses.translation: Those arms had wounds made by stabbing from the pointed edges of tusks of Iraavata and fleshy shoulders smeared with diamond and hit by Vishnu chakra.

glosses.meaning: (those arms had) wounds made by stabbing
from the pointed edges of tusks of Iraavata

verses.devanagari:
पीनौ समसुजात अंसौ सम्गतौ बल सम्युतौ |
सुलक्षण नख अन्गुष्ठौ स्वन्गुली तल लक्षितौ
verses.iast:
pīnau samasujāta aṃsau samgatau bala samyutau |
sulakṣaṇa nakha anguṣṭhau svangulī tala lakṣitau
verses.translation: These arms of Ravana were corpulent with well grown and equal strong shoulders proportionate to body, with knees and thumbs of good characteristics, with good fingers and palms.

glosses.meaning: with well grown and equal shoulders
with knees and thumbs of good characteristic

verses.devanagari:
सम्हतौ परिघ आकारौ व्र्त्तौ करि कर उपमौ |
विक्षिप्तौ शयने शुभ्रे पन्च शीर्षाव् इव उरगौ
verses.iast:
samhatau parigha ākārau vrttau kari kara upamau |
vikṣiptau śayane śubhre panca śīrṣāv iva uragau
verses.translation: With strong joints in the shape of club, round in shape resembling the trunks of an elephant, like five headed snakes thrown on clean couch.

glosses.meaning: resembling the trunks of an elephant

verses.devanagari:
शश क्षतज कल्पेन सुशीतेन सुगन्धिना |
चन्दनेन पर अर्ध्येन स्वनुलिप्तौ स्वलम्क्र्तौ
उत्तम स्त्री विम्र्दितौ गन्ध उत्तम निषेवितौ |
यक्ष पन्नग गन्धर्व देव दानव राविणौ
verses.iast:
śaśa kṣataja kalpena suśītena sugandhinā |
candanena para ardhyena svanuliptau svalamkrtau
uttama strī vimrditau gandha uttama niṣevitau |
yakṣa pannaga gandharva deva dānava rāviṇau
verses.translation: Shoulders well smeared by best sandal with good smell and very cool resembling in color to a hare's blood, well decorated, massaged by the best women, served by the best sandal and which made yakshas, nagas, gandharvas, devas and daanavaas scream.

verses.devanagari:
ददर्श स कपिः तस्य बाहू शयन संस्थितौ |
मन्दरस्य अन्तरे सुप्तौ महा अर्ही रुषिताव् इव
verses.iast:
dadarśa sa kapiḥ tasya bāhū śayana saṃsthitau |
mandarasya antare suptau mahā arhī ruṣitāv iva
verses.translation: That Hanuma saw there arms on the couch like great serpents in anger sleeping in the middle of mount Mandara.

glosses.meaning: in the middle of mount Mandara.

verses.devanagari:
ताभ्याम् स परिपूर्णाभ्याम् भुजाभ्याम् राक्षस अधिपः |
शुशुभे अचल सम्काशः श्र्न्गाभ्याम् इव मन्दरः
verses.iast:
tābhyām sa paripūrṇābhyām bhujābhyām rākṣasa adhipaḥ |
śuśubhe acala samkāśaḥ śrngābhyām iva mandaraḥ
verses.translation: That king of Rakshasas equaling a mountain with those shoulders, which were well built and shone like Mount Mandara with twin peaks.

verses.devanagari:
चूत पुम्नाग सुरभिर् बकुल उत्तम सम्युतः |
मृष्ट अन्न रस सम्युक्तः पान गन्ध पुरः सरः
तस्य राक्षस सिम्हस्य निश्चक्राम मुखान् महान् |
शयानस्य विनिह्श्वासः पूरयन्न् इव तद् ग्र्हम्
verses.iast:
cūta pumnāga surabhir bakula uttama samyutaḥ |
mṛṣṭa anna rasa samyuktaḥ pāna gandha puraḥ saraḥ
tasya rākṣasa simhasya niścakrāma mukhān mahān |
śayānasya vinihśvāsaḥ pūrayann iva tad grham
verses.translation: From the great face of that king of Rakshasas who was sleeping, came out breath with fragrance like that of flowers of chuuta and punnaaga, consisting of the best fragrance of Vakula flowers, together with the flavor of best cooked rice, with the smell of liquor as though filling that house.

glosses.meaning: fragrant like the flowers of chuuta and punnaaga
consisting of the best fragrance of Vakula flowers
together with the flavor of best cooked rice

verses.devanagari:
मुक्ता मणि विचित्रेण कान्चनेन विराजता |
मुकुटेन अपव्र्त्तेन कुण्डल उज्ज्वलित आननम्
रक्त चन्दन दिग्धेन तथा हारेण शोभिता |
पीन आयत विशालेन वक्षसा अभिविराजितम्
पाण्डुरेण अपविद्धेन क्षौमेण क्षतज ईक्षणम् |
महा अर्हेण सुसम्वीतम् पीतेन उत्तम वाससा
माष राशि प्रतीकाशम् निह्श्वसन्तम् भुजन्गवत् |
गान्गे महति तोय अन्ते प्रसुतमिव कुन्जरम्
चतुर्भिः कान्चनैर् दीपैर् दीप्यमानैः चतुर् दिशम् |
प्रकाशी क्र्त सर्व अन्गम् मेघम् विद्युद् गणैर् इव
पाद मूल गताः च अपि ददर्श सुमहात्मनः |
पत्नीः स प्रिय भार्यस्य तस्य रक्षः पतेर् ग्र्हे
verses.iast:
muktā maṇi vicitreṇa kāncanena virājatā |
mukuṭena apavrttena kuṇḍala ujjvalita ānanam
rakta candana digdhena tathā hāreṇa śobhitā |
pīna āyata viśālena vakṣasā abhivirājitam
pāṇḍureṇa apaviddhena kṣaumeṇa kṣataja īkṣaṇam |
mahā arheṇa susamvītam pītena uttama vāsasā
māṣa rāśi pratīkāśam nihśvasantam bhujangavat |
gānge mahati toya ante prasutamiva kunjaram
caturbhiḥ kāncanair dīpair dīpyamānaiḥ catur diśam |
prakāśī krta sarva angam megham vidyud gaṇair iva
pāda mūla gatāḥ ca api dadarśa sumahātmanaḥ |
patnīḥ sa priya bhāryasya tasya rakṣaḥ pater grhe
verses.translation: That Hanuma saw in the house of that king of Rakshasa's, wives at the feet, Ravana being a gigantic one with loving wives, shone with crown tilted to the side, having strange hue with pearls and diamonds and of golden colour, with a face made brilliant by earrings, shone with the chest region smeared with red sandal, shining with a necklace wide, high and corpulent with a silk cloth of white colour falling on him, with eyes reddish like blood, well tied by a best cloth of yellow colour and of very best quality, resembling a heap of black beans, snoring like a hiss of a snake, like an elephant sleeping in the middle of water belonging to the great river Ganga with all the four directions shone by the four lamps of golden colour, resembling a cloud with all the parts being shone by groups of lighting.

glosses.meaning: in the house of that king of Rakshasa's
with crown tilted to the side
having strange hue with pearls and diamonds
with a face made brilliant made by earrings
resembling a heap of black beans
like a hiss of a snake
belonging to the great river Ganga
with all the four directions shone
with all the parts being shone

verses.devanagari:
शशि प्रकाश वदना वर कुण्डल भूषिताः |
अम्बाल माल्य आभरणा ददर्श हरि यूथपः
verses.iast:
śaśi prakāśa vadanā vara kuṇḍala bhūṣitāḥ |
ambāla mālya ābharaṇā dadarśa hari yūthapaḥ
verses.translation: The leader of Vanaras saw those wives of Ravana with faces with radiance of moon, adorned with beautiful earrings, wearing jewellery and flower garlands which were not worn out.

glosses.meaning: (those wives of Ravana) with faces with radiance of moon
wearing jewellery and flower garlands which were not worn out.

verses.devanagari:
नृत्त वादित्र कुशला राक्षस इन्द्र भुज अन्कगाः |
वर आभरण धारिण्यो निषन्ना दद्र्शे कपिः
verses.iast:
nṛtta vāditra kuśalā rākṣasa indra bhuja ankagāḥ |
vara ābharaṇa dhāriṇyo niṣannā dadrśe kapiḥ
verses.translation: Hanuma saw wives of Ravana with skill in dance and musical instruments, who obtained the shoulders of Ravana wearing the best jewellery and being in sleep.

glosses.meaning: (wives of Ravana) with skill in dance and musical instruments

verses.devanagari:
वज्र वैदूर्य गर्भाणि श्रवण अन्तेषु योषिताम् |
ददर्श तापनीयानि कुण्डलानि अन्गदानि च
verses.iast:
vajra vaidūrya garbhāṇi śravaṇa anteṣu yoṣitām |
dadarśa tāpanīyāni kuṇḍalāni angadāni ca
verses.translation: He saw earrings of those women at the end of ears with embedded diamonds and cats eye gems and having golden colour.

glosses.meaning: with embedded diamonds and cats eye gems

verses.devanagari:
तासाम् चन्द्र उपमैर् वक्त्रैः शुभैर् ललित कुण्डलैः |
विरराज विमानम् तन् नभः तारा गणैर् इव
verses.iast:
tāsām candra upamair vaktraiḥ śubhair lalita kuṇḍalaiḥ |
virarāja vimānam tan nabhaḥ tārā gaṇair iva
verses.translation: With the faces of those women with delicate earrings which were equal to moon and auspicious that house shone like the sky with clusters of stars.

verses.devanagari:
मद व्यायाम खिन्नाः ताः राक्षस इन्द्रस्य योषितः |
तेषु तेष्व् अवकाशेषु प्रसुप्ताः तनु मध्यमाः
verses.iast:
mada vyāyāma khinnāḥ tāḥ rākṣasa indrasya yoṣitaḥ |
teṣu teṣv avakāśeṣu prasuptāḥ tanu madhyamāḥ
verses.translation: Women of that Ravana being tired from lustful passion and exertion and having lean waists slept at first opportunity.

glosses.meaning: being tired from lustful passion and exertion

verses.devanagari:
अङ्गहारैस्तथैवान्या कोवलैर्नृत्तशालिनी |
विन्यस्तशुभसर्वाङ्गी प्रसुप्ता वरवर्णिनी
verses.iast:
aṇ^gahāraistathaivānyā kovalairnṛttaśālinī |
vinyastaśubhasarvāṇ^gī prasuptā varavarṇinī
verses.translation: Another woman with skill in dancing consisting of delicate body postures slept in the same way with all her body parts making the same dance postures.

glosses.meaning: with all her body parts making the same dance postures.

verses.devanagari:
काचिद् वीणाम् परिष्वज्य प्रसुप्ता सम्प्रकाशते |
महा नदी प्रकीर्णा इव नलिनी पोतम् आश्रिता
verses.iast:
kācid vīṇām pariṣvajya prasuptā samprakāśate |
mahā nadī prakīrṇā iva nalinī potam āśritā
verses.translation: One woman hugging veena and sleeping was shining like a lotus plant thrown away by the flow of a great river and resorting a boat.

glosses.meaning: thrown away by( the flow of) a great river

verses.devanagari:
अन्या कक्ष गतेन एव मड्डुकेन असित ईक्षणा |
प्रसुप्ता भामिनी भाति बाल पुत्रा इव वत्सला
verses.iast:
anyā kakṣa gatena eva maḍḍukena asita īkṣaṇā |
prasuptā bhāminī bhāti bāla putrā iva vatsalā
verses.translation: Another woman with black eyes sleeping with an instrument called madduka under arm pit shone like a woman carrying an infant boy with love.

verses.devanagari:
पटहम् चारु सर्व अन्गी पीड्य शेते शुभ स्तनी |
चिरस्य रमणम् लब्ध्वा परिष्वज्य इव कामिनी
verses.iast:
paṭaham cāru sarva angī pīḍya śete śubha stanī |
cirasya ramaṇam labdhvā pariṣvajya iva kāminī
verses.translation: A woman with beautiful body features and with beautiful breasts slept tightly and hugged instrument called pataha as though hugging a lover, getting him after a long time.

verses.devanagari:
काचिद् अंशम् परिष्वज्य सुप्ता कमल लोचना |
रहः प्रियतमम् गृह्य सकामेव च कामिनी
verses.iast:
kācid aṃśam pariṣvajya suptā kamala locanā |
rahaḥ priyatamam gṛhya sakāmeva ca kāminī
verses.translation: Another woman with lotus like eyes hugging a flute slept like a woman with lust holding her lover in secret.

verses.devanagari:
विपञ्चैइम् परिगृह्यान्या नियता नृत्तशालिनी |
निद्रा वशम् अनुप्राप्ता सह कान्ता इव भामिनी
verses.iast:
vipaJṇcaiim parigṛhyānyā niyatā nṛttaśālinī |
nidrā vaśam anuprāptā saha kāntā iva bhāminī
verses.translation: Another woman skilled in dance obtained sleep getting an instrument like veena and being in tune with it like a woman together with her lover.

glosses.meaning: getting vipanJNchiim = an instrument like veena

verses.devanagari:
अन्या कनक सम्काशैर् म्र्दु पीनैर् मनो रमैः |
मृदन्गम् परिपीड्य अन्गैः प्रसुप्ता मत्त लोचना
verses.iast:
anyā kanaka samkāśair mrdu pīnair mano ramaiḥ |
mṛdangam paripīḍya angaiḥ prasuptā matta locanā
verses.translation: Another woman with lusty eyes slept hugging a percussion instrument called mridanga with her body parts which were pleasant which resembled gold and which were smooth and fleshy.

glosses.meaning: and which were smooth and fleshy.

verses.devanagari:
भुज पार्श्व अन्तरस्थेन कक्षगेन क्र्श उदरी |
पणवेन सह अनिन्द्या सुप्ता मद क्र्त श्रमा
verses.iast:
bhuja pārśva antarasthena kakṣagena krśa udarī |
paṇavena saha anindyā suptā mada krta śramā
verses.translation: Another woman with thin stomach, who was not to be blamed, slept due to tiresomeness from lust together with an instrument called Padama between her shoulders and reaching arm pits.

glosses.meaning: who was not to be blamed
together with an instrument called Padama

verses.devanagari:
डिण्डिमम् परिग्र्ह्य अन्या तथैव आसक्त डिण्डिमा |
प्रसुप्ता तरुणम् वत्सम् उपगूह्य इव भामिनी
verses.iast:
ḍiṇḍimam parigrhya anyā tathaiva āsakta ḍiṇḍimā |
prasuptā taruṇam vatsam upagūhya iva bhāminī
verses.translation: Another woman with an instrument called Dindima near her slept in the same way as a woman hugging her husband and also her child.

glosses.meaning: with an instrument called Dindima near her

verses.devanagari:
काचिद् आडम्बरम् नारी भुज सम्भोग पीडितम् |
कृत्वा कमल पत्र अक्षी प्रसुप्ता मद मोहिता
verses.iast:
kācid āḍambaram nārī bhuja sambhoga pīḍitam |
kṛtvā kamala patra akṣī prasuptā mada mohitā
verses.translation: Another woman with eyes like lotus petals slept making the instrument called adambara pressing it by her shoulders being desired by lust.

verses.devanagari:
कलशीम् अपविद्ध्य अन्या प्रसुप्ता भाति भामिनी |
वसन्ते पुष्प शबला माला इव परिमार्जिता
verses.iast:
kalaśīm apaviddhya anyā prasuptā bhāti bhāminī |
vasante puṣpa śabalā mālā iva parimārjitā
verses.translation: Another woman sleeping, felling down a small pot, shone like a flower garland with the flowers of strange hue made auspicious in spring.

glosses.meaning: with the flowers of strange hue

verses.devanagari:
पाणिभ्याम् च कुचौ काचित् सुवर्ण कलश उपमौ |
उपगूह्य अबला सुप्ता निद्रा बल पराजिता
verses.iast:
pāṇibhyām ca kucau kācit suvarṇa kalaśa upamau |
upagūhya abalā suptā nidrā bala parājitā
verses.translation: Another woman slept hugging her breasts resembling golden pots by her hands, overcome with sleep.

verses.devanagari:
अन्या कमल पत्र अक्षी पूर्ण इन्दु सद्र्श आनना |
अन्याम् आलिन्ग्य सुश्रोणी प्रसुप्ता मद विह्वला
verses.iast:
anyā kamala patra akṣī pūrṇa indu sadrśa ānanā |
anyām ālingya suśroṇī prasuptā mada vihvalā
verses.translation: Another woman with eyes like lotus petals, with her face resembling full moon, overcome with lust slept hugging another woman with a beautiful hip region.

glosses.meaning: with her face resembling full moon

verses.devanagari:
आतोद्यानि विचित्राणि परिष्वज्य वर स्त्रियः |
निपीड्य च कुचैः सुप्ताः कामिन्यः कामुकान् इव
verses.iast:
ātodyāni vicitrāṇi pariṣvajya vara striyaḥ |
nipīḍya ca kucaiḥ suptāḥ kāminyaḥ kāmukān iva
verses.translation: Some excellent women slept hugging strange instruments and pressing them with breasts as though lustful woman with lusty men.

glosses.meaning: as though lustful woman with lusty men

verses.devanagari:
तासाम् एक अन्त विन्यस्ते शयानाम् शयने शुभे |
ददर्श रूप सम्पन्नाम् अपराम् स कपिः स्त्रियम्
verses.iast:
tāsām eka anta vinyaste śayānām śayane śubhe |
dadarśa rūpa sampannām aparām sa kapiḥ striyam
verses.translation: That Hanuma saw among those women a very beautiful woman sleeping on an auspicious couch arranged alone at a side.

verses.devanagari:
मुक्ता मणि समायुक्तैर् भूषणैः सुविभूषिताम् |
विभूषयन्तीम् इव च स्व श्रिया भवन उत्तमम्
गौरीम् कनक वर्ण आभाम् इष्टाम् अन्तः पुर ईश्वरीम् |
कपिर् मन्द उदरीम् तत्र शयानाम् चारु रूपिणीम्
verses.iast:
muktā maṇi samāyuktair bhūṣaṇaiḥ suvibhūṣitām |
vibhūṣayantīm iva ca sva śriyā bhavana uttamam
gaurīm kanaka varṇa ābhām iṣṭām antaḥ pura īśvarīm |
kapir manda udarīm tatra śayānām cāru rūpiṇīm
verses.translation: Hanuma saw Mandodari with a beautiful form together with diamonds and pearls, well decorated by jewellery and with her self radiance as though decorating that great building with a fair complexion and with a radiance like golden colour, who was dear to her husband the lady of women in that gynaeceum sleeping there.

glosses.meaning: as though decorating bhavanottamam = that great building
and with a radiance like golden colour
who was dear to her husband
the lady of the women in that gynaeceum

verses.devanagari:
स ताम् दृष्ट्वा महा बाहुर् भूषिताम् मारुत आत्मजः |
तर्कयाम् आस सीता इति रूप यौवन सम्पदा
हर्षेण महता युक्तो ननन्द हरि यूथपः |
verses.iast:
sa tām dṛṣṭvā mahā bāhur bhūṣitām māruta ātmajaḥ |
tarkayām āsa sītā iti rūpa yauvana sampadā
harṣeṇa mahatā yukto nananda hari yūthapaḥ |
verses.translation: That Hanuma with great arms seeing the woman well decorated, out of logic thought thus: "This is Seetha by the wealth of her appearance and her youth". That warrior of Vanaras was delighted together with great pleasure.

glosses.meaning: by the wealth of her appearance and her youth

verses.devanagari:
आश्पोटयाम् आस चुचुम्ब पुच्चम् |
ननन्द चिक्रीड जगौ जगाम|
स्तम्भान् अरोहन् निपपात भूमौ |
निदर्शयन् स्वाम् प्रक्र्तिम् कपीनाम्
verses.iast:
āśpoṭayām āsa cucumba puccam |
nananda cikrīḍa jagau jagāma |
stambhān arohan nipapāta bhūmau |
nidarśayan svām prakrtim kapīnām
verses.translation: He clasped his arms, kissed his tail he was delighted, he was playful, sang, paced showing his simian nature, climbed pillars and fell down on land.
